_notes: THE EMBER ATLAS -- eight stills, one per cell, NOT a sequence: the emitter
picks one per particle by hash (SpellEmitterSim.At, channel 6), so the folder
is a palette and the order only decides which index a hash lands on.
EXPLICIT RECTS, the README's own boundaries -- same 1774x887 4x2 delivery,
same 444/443 alternation as water's and the contact sheet above. Checked:
none of the eight cells' ink bboxes touch a rect edge at this size, so unlike
water's drops sheet there is no measured neighbour-bleed here -- rects are
still stated because the sheet genuinely does not divide evenly and a floor
grid would silently drift by the fourth column regardless of what today's
content happens to reach.
WHAT EACH CELL ACTUALLY IS, looked at rather than assumed uniform: c0 a round
ember ball; c1 an elongated spark streak; c2 a glowing coal fragment (angular,
reads as a cooling chunk rather than a lick of flame); c3 and c4 crescent arc
streaks; c5 and c6 upright flame licks (c6 a taller double-lick, closer to a
small phoenix-wing shape); c7 a small coal chip with two tiny attached sparks.
Named for what they are rather than left as f0..f7, so the shed and the spray
in skills.json can be read without opening the sheet.
NO CANVAS STATED: the rects give 444x444/443x443 cells and nothing here
scales, so the automatic pad onto the largest (444x444) is sufficient.
Delivered with its own alpha; keyed is false.
